name: Investigate the Camp

angles.text: A rumored gathering of big-game hunters led by the renowned Hemet Nesingwary naturally draws tracking and marksmanship enthusiasts looking to test their mettle in the jungle.
Hemet Nesingwary is among the most famous dwarven marksmen and adventurers, making his presence in the distant southern wilds of Stranglethorn Vale a point of pride and curiosity.

faq.answer: Krazek, an operative stationed in the neutral goblin port of Booty Bay, commissions travelers to seek out the encampment and report back its exact whereabouts.
faq.q: Who gives the task to investigate the camp?

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary is a renowned dwarven big-game hunter and explorer. Word has reached Booty Bay that he is among the hunters camping near Lake Nazferiti, sparking interest due to his extensive reputation and connections.
The hunters have established their campsite upriver from the Venture Company's mining operations along Lake Nazferiti in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: Where is the hunters' camp located?

faq.answer: Normally a remote hunters' camp wouldn't draw much interest from Booty Bay, but reports that a figure as influential and well-connected as Hemet Nesingwary is present raised caution and curiosity.
faq.q: Why is Krazek interested in this hunting camp?

faq.answer: The hunters are not part of the Venture Company; their campsite simply lies upriver from the goblin syndicate's mining outfit near Lake Nazferiti, serving as a geographic landmark.
faq.q: What is the hunters' relationship to the Venture Company?

aliases: what do you do after finding camp
where to turn in investigate camp
faq.answer: Once the campsite along the river has been located and scouted, you return south to Booty Bay to deliver the report directly to Krazek.
faq.q: To whom do you report after finding the camp?

sections.body: Reports circulating through the docks of Booty Bay speak of an expedition of big-game hunters encamped in the northern jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. Word has reached Krazek that the camp lies along the river just past the Venture Company's busy mining claim near Lake Nazferiti. In a lawless jungle teeming with dangers and competing interests, unexplained armed encampments always demand a watchful eye.
sections.title: Reports in the Jungle

sections.body: What makes this particular expedition notable is the rumored presence of Hemet Nesingwary himself. The renowned dwarven marksman is known throughout the lands as an elite explorer with influential ties. Krazek prefers to take no chances with powerful figures operating in the hinterlands, sending scouts upriver to confirm whether the legendary hunter has truly arrived.
sections.title: A Renowned Marksman

summary: Investigate the Camp is an expedition task originating in Booty Bay to scout a newly established hunters' campsite in Stranglethorn Vale. Commissioned by Krazek, it tasks travelers with confirming rumors that the legendary dwarven marksman Hemet Nesingwary has arrived near Lake Nazferiti.
